# connection

The Prometheus local connection — its native configuration, the `prometheus.bearer` profile and the configured identity probe that proves a credential.

`connectors_prometheus.connection` is one of connectors_prometheus's bounded contexts. [Back to the index](../index.md).

## Types

### `BearerEntry`

`connectors_prometheus.connection.BearerEntry` is a record of one field:

- `token` — `connectors_prometheus.connection.BearerToken`

### `BearerProfile`

`connectors_prometheus.connection.BearerProfile` is a record of nine fields:

- `id` — `String`
- `scheme` — `String`
- `capability` — `String`
- `purpose` — `String`
- `subject` — `String`
- `minimum_scopes` — `List<String>`
- `evidence_lifetime_ms` — `Integer`
- `entry` — `String`
- `identity` — `connectors_prometheus.connection.IdentityProbe`

Every value satisfies `id == "prometheus.bearer"`, `scheme == "http_bearer"`, `capability == "http-bearer"`, `purpose == "service_account"`, `subject == "app"`, `minimum_scopes.count == 0`, `evidence_lifetime_ms == 60000` and `entry == "connectors_prometheus.connection.BearerEntry"`.

### `BearerToken`

`connectors_prometheus.connection.BearerToken` wraps `String` and is not interchangeable with one: the whole value of naming it separately is the crossings the model then refuses. Its characters are drawn from `!"#$%&'()*+,-./0123456789:;<=>?@ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ[\]^_`abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz\{|\}~`. Every value satisfies `(value.count >= 1 and value.count &lt;= 8192)`.

### `IdentityProbe`

`connectors_prometheus.connection.IdentityProbe` is a record of four fields:

- `method` — `String`
- `path` — `String`
- `source` — `connectors_prometheus.connection.IdentitySource`
- `kind` — `String`

Every value satisfies `method == "GET"`, `path == "api/v1/status/buildinfo"` and `kind == "prometheus.connection"`.

### `IdentitySource`

`connectors_prometheus.connection.IdentitySource` is one of `configuration`.

### `InstanceId`

`connectors_prometheus.connection.InstanceId` wraps `String` and is not interchangeable with one: the whole value of naming it separately is the crossings the model then refuses. Its characters are drawn from `ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789_.-`. Every value satisfies `(value.count >= 1 and value.count <= 128)`.

### `LocalConfiguration`

`connectors_prometheus.connection.LocalConfiguration` is a record of five fields:

- `format` — `String`
- `instance` — `connectors_prometheus.connection.InstanceId`
- `base_url` — `String`
- `ca_file` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent
- `query_scope` — `connectors_prometheus.connection.QueryScope`

Every value satisfies `format == "connectors-prometheus-local/1"`, `(base_url.count >= 8 and base_url.count <= 512)`, `base_url starts_with "https://"` and `(ca_file.count >= 1 and ca_file.count <= 4096)`.

### `QueryScope`

`connectors_prometheus.connection.QueryScope` is a record of one field:

- `allowed_matchers` — `List<String>`

Every value satisfies `allowed_matchers.count == 0`.

Three of the types above are reached by nothing else in this system: `connectors_prometheus.connection.BearerEntry`, `connectors_prometheus.connection.BearerProfile` and `connectors_prometheus.connection.LocalConfiguration`. No entity, view, command, event, error or crossing names them, so it is either vocabulary something outside this specification uses or a leftover — and only a person can tell which.
